content: Microsoft Graph throttling (Microsoft Learn, updated 2025-08-06). Exceeding a threshold returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After response header (seconds) and a JSON body with error.code = TooManyRequests and innerError.code = 429. Guidance: wait exactly Retry-After seconds then retry; repeat while 429 continues; do NOT retry immediately because throttled requests still accrue against usage limits. If no Retry-After header is present, use exponential backoff. Thresholds differ per request type (writes throttle before reads). Polling a resource repeatedly or rescanning collections is called out as a pattern that causes throttling - use delta/change tracking instead. Inside a JSON batch, individual sub-requests are evaluated separately and can each return 429 while the batch returns 200; SDK auto-retry does not apply to batched sub-requests.
